introduction.text: Domus delle Gorgoni is a Roman domus from the Constantinian age located near Porta Laurentina in region I of Ostia.

history.description: Domus delle Gorgoni is a domus dating to the Constantinian age, located near Porta Laurentina in region I of Ostia.

design.description: The building has a trapezoidal plan with a piazzetta, vestibule, two corridors, a courtyard, and a mosaic floor.

art.description: The interior features black and white geometric mosaics with a gorgone motif.
